theorems.statement: For all real numbers x and y, if x > 0 and y > 0, then xy > 0
theorems.proof: Let x and y be positive real numbers. Since x > 0 and y > 0, by the properties of multiplication of positive numbers, their product xy > 0. [QED]

theorems.statement: The sum of two even numbers is even
theorems.proof: Let a and b be even numbers. Then a = 2k and b = 2m where k, m are integers. Therefore, a + b = 2k + 2m = 2(k + m), which is even. [QED]

theorems.statement: If f is continuous on [a,b] and f(a)f(b) < 0, then there exists c in (a,b) such that f(c) = 0
theorems.proof: Since f is continuous on [a,b] and f(a)f(b) < 0, either f(a) < 0 and f(b) > 0, or f(a) > 0 and f(b) < 0. By the Intermediate Value Theorem, there exists c in (a,b) such that f(c) = 0. [QED]
